import R1Z.ProverCommitNativeQInverse49
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeQ
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode)
open ProverCommitNativeQ48 (source)

theorem zero_exact (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) :
    kernels.inverse_q (source x) = ok none ↔ decode x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    obtain ⟨z,hz,_,_⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQInverse49.inverse x hx hn
    rw [h] at hz
    cases hz
  · intro hz
    have he := (ProverCommitNativeQInverse49.zero_iff x hx).mp hz
    rw [kernels.inverse_q,ProverCommitNativeQInverse49.zero_test]
    simp only [he,decide_true,if_true,bind_tc_ok]

theorem nonzero_test (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hn : decode x ≠ 0) :
    field.QM31.is_zero (source x) = ok false := by
  have h : x ≠ zero := by
    intro hz
    exact hn ((ProverCommitNativeQInverse49.zero_iff x hx).mpr hz)
  rw [ProverCommitNativeQInverse49.zero_test]
  simp only [h,decide_false]

theorem subtract_nonzero (chi slot : Old.Q) (hc : Canonical chi) (hs : Canonical slot)
    (hn : decode chi ≠ decode slot) :
    ∃ operand inverse : Old.Q,
      field.QM31.sub (source chi) (source slot) = ok (source operand) ∧
      Canonical operand ∧ decode operand ≠ 0 ∧
      field.QM31.is_zero (source operand) = ok false ∧
      kernels.inverse_q (source operand) = ok (some (source inverse)) ∧ Canonical inverse := by
  obtain ⟨operand,ho,hco,hdo⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.sub chi slot hc hs
  have hno : decode operand ≠ 0 := by rw [hdo]; exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hn
  obtain ⟨inverse,hi,hci,_⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQInverse49.inverse operand hco hno
  exact ⟨operand,inverse,ho,hco,hno,nonzero_test operand hco hno,hi,hci⟩

#print axioms zero_exact
#print axioms nonzero_test
#print axioms subtract_nonzero
end R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeQ

import R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeQ
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeNormQ
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode)

theorem norm_operand (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hn : decode x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a b r n : Old.C,
      field.CM31.square (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0) = ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source a) ∧
      field.CM31.square (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1) = ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source b) ∧
      kernels.mul_r (ProverCommitNativeC49.source b) = ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source r) ∧
      field.CM31.sub (ProverCommitNativeC49.source a) (ProverCommitNativeC49.source r) = ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source n) ∧
      ProverCommitNativeC49.Canonical n ∧ ProverCommitNativeC49.value n ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hva⟩ := ProverCommitNativeSquare49.square x.c0 hx.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hvb⟩ := ProverCommitNativeSquare49.square x.c1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hcr,hvr⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.mul_r b hcb
  obtain ⟨n,hnn,hcn,hvn⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.sub a r hca hcr
  refine ⟨a,b,r,n,ha,hb,hr,hnn,hcn,?_⟩
  have hnorm : ProverCommitNativeC49.value n = QuadraticAlgebra.norm (decode x) := by
    rw [hvn,hva,hvr,hvb,ProverCommitNativeQInverse49.norm_value]
    change ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0-qm31R*(ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1) = ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0-qm31R*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1
    ring
  intro hz
  exact hn (QuadraticAlgebra.norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero.mp (hnorm.symm.trans hz))

#print axioms norm_operand
end R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeNormQ

import R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeQ
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeNormC
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitNativeC49
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

theorem norm_operand (x : Old.C) (hx : Canonical x) (hn : value x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ aa bb n : U32,
      field.M31.mul x.a x.a = ok aa ∧ field.M31.mul x.b x.b = ok bb ∧
      field.M31.add aa bb = ok n ∧ ProverCommitM31Ops48.canonical n ∧ n ≠ 0#u32 := by
  obtain ⟨aa,haa,hcaa,hvaa⟩ := ProverCommitM31Ops48.mul_exact x.a x.a
  obtain ⟨bb,hbb,hcbb,hvbb⟩ := ProverCommitM31Ops48.mul_exact x.b x.b
  obtain ⟨n,hnn,hcn,hvn⟩ := ProverCommitM31Ops48.add_exact aa bb hcaa hcbb
  refine ⟨aa,bb,n,haa,hbb,hnn,hcn,?_⟩
  have hnorm : ProverCommitM31Ops48.decode n = QuadraticAlgebra.norm (value x) := by
    rw [hvn,hvaa,hvbb,ProverCommitNativeCInverse49.norm_value]
    rfl
  intro hz
  have hzero : ProverCommitM31Ops48.decode n = 0 := by rw [hz]; rfl
  exact hn (QuadraticAlgebra.norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero.mp (hnorm.symm.trans hzero))

#print axioms norm_operand
end R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeNormC

namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_InterpolationSource
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitM31Ops48

theorem source_inverse_operand (i : U8) (bound : i.val<28) :
    ∃ (basis : Array U32 28#usize) (den inv : U32),
      PV_Inv_IInterpolationInitial.prepare i=ok (basis,den) ∧ canonical den ∧
      den ≠ 0#u32 ∧ inverse_ref den=ok inv ∧ canonical inv := by
  obtain ⟨basis,den,hprep,hbasis,hden,hpoly,hvalue,hn⟩ :=
    PV_Inv_IInterpolationInitial.prepare_exact i bound
  obtain ⟨inv,hinv,hcan,hval⟩ := ProverCommitInterpolationInverse48.inverse_exact den hn
  exact ⟨PV_Inv_IM31Array.array 28#usize basis,den,inv,hprep,hden,hn,hinv,hcan⟩

#print axioms source_inverse_operand
end R1Z.PV_Inv_InterpolationSource

namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_Sentinel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47

def constructorInverse (sentinel : U32) : Result (Option U32) :=
  if sentinel=0#u32 then ok none else do
    let inv ← inverse_ref sentinel
    ok (some inv)

theorem zero_reject : constructorInverse (0#u32)=ok none := by simp [constructorInverse]

theorem nonzero_success (s : U32) (nonzero : s ≠ 0#u32) :
    ∃ inv, constructorInverse s=ok (some inv) ∧ inv.val < AspisCircleGroupOrder.P := by
  obtain ⟨inv,hr,hc,_⟩ := ProverCommitInterpolationInverse48.inverse_exact s nonzero
  exact ⟨inv,by simp [constructorInverse,nonzero,hr],hc⟩

#print axioms zero_reject
#print axioms nonzero_success
end R1Z.PV_Inv_Sentinel

import R1Z.PV_Inv_Guard
import Mathlib.Data.List.Find
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_Pivot
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def pivot (xs : List K) : Option K := xs.find? (fun x => decide (x ≠ 0))

theorem selected_nonzero (xs : List K) (v : K) (h : pivot xs = some v) : v ≠ 0 := by
  have := List.find?_some h
  exact of_decide_eq_true this

theorem selected_inverse (xs : List K) (v : K) (h : pivot xs = some v) :
    PV_Inv_Guard.checkedInverse v = some v⁻¹ :=
  PV_Inv_Guard.nonzero_branch v (selected_nonzero xs v h)

#print axioms selected_nonzero
#print axioms selected_inverse
end R1Z.PV_Inv_Pivot

import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Basic

/-! Scalar zero-boundary facts. Source association is kept separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_Guard
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def checkedInverse (x : K) : Option K := if x = 0 then none else some x⁻¹

theorem none_iff (x : K) : checkedInverse x = none ↔ x = 0 := by
  simp [checkedInverse]

theorem nonzero_branch (x : K) (h : x ≠ 0) : checkedInverse x = some x⁻¹ := by
  simp [checkedInverse,h]

theorem difference (chi slot : K) : checkedInverse (chi-slot) = none ↔ chi = slot := by
  rw [none_iff,sub_eq_zero]

theorem guarded (x : K) : (if x = 0 then none else checkedInverse x) = checkedInverse x := by
  by_cases h : x=0 <;> simp [checkedInverse,h]

#print axioms none_iff
#print axioms nonzero_branch
#print axioms difference
#print axioms guarded
end R1Z.PV_Inv_Guard

import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_Circle
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem denominator_factor (t i : K) (hi : i^2 = -1) :
    1+t^2=(t-i)*(t+i) := by
  calc 1+t^2 = t^2-i^2 := by rw [hi]; ring
       _ = (t-i)*(t+i) := by ring

theorem singular_iff (t i : K) (hi : i^2 = -1) :
    1+t^2=0 ↔ t=i ∨ t= -i := by
  rw [denominator_factor t i hi,mul_eq_zero,sub_eq_zero,add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]

theorem denominator_nonzero (t i : K) (hi : i^2 = -1)
    (hp : t ≠ i) (hm : t ≠ -i) : 1+t^2 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  exact ((singular_iff t i hi).mp h).elim hp hm

#print axioms denominator_factor
#print axioms singular_iff
#print axioms denominator_nonzero
end R1Z.PV_Inv_Circle

import R1Z.PV_Inv_Circle
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Subfield.Basic
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_CircleSubfield
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem outside_subfield_safe (S : Subfield K) (i t : K) (hi : i^2 = -1)
    (contained : i ∈ S) (outside : t ∉ S) : 1+t^2 ≠ 0 := by
  apply PV_Inv_Circle.denominator_nonzero t i hi
  · intro he
    exact outside (he ▸ contained)
  · intro he
    apply outside
    rw [he]
    exact S.neg_mem contained

#print axioms outside_subfield_safe
end R1Z.PV_Inv_CircleSubfield

import R1Z.PV_Inv_CompressTuple
import R1Z.PV_Inv_RegistryNoPole
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeRegistry
open R0P R0Z.HonestValidity
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitNativeQ48 (source)
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

theorem producer (t : Trace QM31Exact) (lambda chi : Old.Q)
    (hl : Canonical lambda) (hc : Canonical chi) (tag : U32) (htag : tag.val < AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)
    (limbs : Fin 16 → U32) (link : CopyLink) (member : link ∈ copyLinks)
    (active : CopyActiveRow link.producer.row) (safe : NoPole t (decode lambda) (decode chi))
    (input_join : PV_Inv_WordTuple.tuple tag limbs=
      copyEndpointTuple t link.tag link.producer) :
    ∃ slot operand inv : Old.Q,
      PV_Inv_NativeCompress.loop (source lambda) (source (PV_Inv_EmbedTag.liftWord tag))
        (source lambda) (List.ofFn limbs)=ok (source slot) ∧
      Canonical slot ∧ field.QM31.sub (source chi) (source slot)=ok (source operand) ∧
      Canonical operand ∧ decode operand ≠ 0 ∧ field.QM31.is_zero (source operand)=ok false ∧
      kernels.inverse_q (source operand)=ok (some (source inv)) ∧ Canonical inv := by
  obtain ⟨slot,hcomp,hcs,hvs⟩ := PV_Inv_CompressTuple.compress_exact lambda hl tag htag limbs
  rw [input_join] at hvs
  have hn : decode chi ≠ decode slot := by
    rw [hvs]
    exact PV_Inv_RegistryNoPole.producer t (decode lambda) (decode chi) link member active safe
  obtain ⟨d,inv,hd,hcd,hnd,ht,hi,hci⟩ := PV_Inv_NativeQ.subtract_nonzero chi slot hc hcs hn
  exact ⟨slot,d,inv,hcomp,hcs,hd,hcd,hnd,ht,hi,hci⟩

#print axioms producer
end R1Z.PV_Inv_NativeRegistry

import R1Z.PV_Inv_RawNative
import R1Z.PV_Inv_Scan

namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_NativePackScan
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode)
open PV_Inv_RawSlots PV_Inv_RawRun PV_Inv_RawInvoke
open ProverCommitNativeQ48 (source)
local instance : DecidableEq U32 := Classical.decEq _

theorem guarded_packing (chi : Old.Q) (hc : Canonical chi)
    (es : List (Entry Old.Q U32)) (s : Slots Old.Q U32)
    (canon : ∀ e ∈ es, Canonical e.value)
    (guard : PV_Inv_Scan.scan (decode chi) true (es.map (fun e => decode e.value)) = true)
    (hr : run (empty zero) es=some s) :
    ∀ slot ∈ reached s, ∃ operand inverse : Old.Q,
      field.QM31.sub (source chi) (source slot)=ok (source operand) ∧
      Canonical operand ∧ decode operand ≠ 0 ∧ field.QM31.is_zero (source operand)=ok false ∧
      kernels.inverse_q (source operand)=ok (some (source inverse)) ∧ Canonical inverse := by
  apply PV_Inv_RawNative.packed_nonzero chi hc es s canon _ hr
  intro e he
  exact ((PV_Inv_Scan.scan_iff (decode chi) true _).mp guard).2 (decode e.value)
    (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,he,rfl⟩)

#print axioms guarded_packing
end R1Z.PV_Inv_NativePackScan

import R1Z.PoleMassR1
import R1Z.PV_Inv_ModelPack
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_BadContainment
open R0P R0Z.HonestValidity PV_Inv_Pack PV_Inv_ModelRow PV_Inv_PackOperands
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

theorem producer_zero_is_pole (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) (b : Fin 1024)
    (active : CopyActiveRow b) (weights : Fin 2 → K) (s : Slots K)
    (run : PV_Inv_PackList.run PV_Inv_Pack.empty (entries t lam b CopyLink.producer weights)=some s)
    (zero : 0 ∈ operands chi s) : ¬ NoPole t lam chi := by
  intro hp
  exact PV_Inv_ModelPack.producer t lam chi b active weights hp s run 0 zero rfl

theorem consumer_zero_is_pole (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) (b : Fin 1024)
    (active : CopyActiveRow b) (weights : Fin 2 → K) (s : Slots K)
    (run : PV_Inv_PackList.run PV_Inv_Pack.empty (entries t lam b CopyLink.consumer weights)=some s)
    (zero : 0 ∈ operands chi s) : ¬ NoPole t lam chi := by
  intro hp
  exact PV_Inv_ModelPack.consumer t lam chi b active weights hp s run 0 zero rfl

#print axioms producer_zero_is_pole
#print axioms consumer_zero_is_pole
end R1Z.PV_Inv_BadContainment

import R1Z.PV_Inv_PoleMass
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_ChargeRules
open R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV

theorem already_charged {C : Type} [Fintype C] (zero old : C → Prop) (bound : ℚ)
    (subset : ∀ c, zero c → old c) (charged : eventMass old ≤ bound) : eventMass zero ≤ bound :=
  (eventMass_mono zero old subset).trans charged

theorem no_double_charge {C : Type} [Fintype C] (zero old : C → Prop)
    (subset : ∀ c, zero c → old c) : eventMass (fun c => old c ∨ zero c)=eventMass old := by
  congr 1
  funext c
  exact propext ⟨fun h => h.elim id (subset c),Or.inl⟩

#print axioms already_charged
#print axioms no_double_charge
end R1Z.PV_Inv_ChargeRules

import R1Z.PV_Inv_BadContainment
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_PoleMass
open R0Z.JointView R0P R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HvzkV
open PV_Inv_Pack PV_Inv_ModelRow PV_Inv_PackOperands PoleMassR1
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- Existentially ranges over both side packs, every active row, every weight,
and every reached operand, so no union bound is charged per invocation. -/
def zeroEvent (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : Fin 1024, CopyActiveRow b ∧ ∃ weights : Fin 2 → K, ∃ s : Slots K,
   (PV_Inv_PackList.run PV_Inv_Pack.empty (entries t lam b CopyLink.producer weights)=some s ∨
    PV_Inv_PackList.run PV_Inv_Pack.empty (entries t lam b CopyLink.consumer weights)=some s) ∧
    0 ∈ operands chi s

theorem contained (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) (hz : zeroEvent t lam chi) : ¬ NoPole t lam chi := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,w,s,hr,hz⟩ := hz
  rcases hr with hp|hc
  · exact PV_Inv_BadContainment.producer_zero_is_pole t lam chi b hb w s hp hz
  · exact PV_Inv_BadContainment.consumer_zero_is_pole t lam chi b hb w s hc hz

theorem mass {C : Type} [Fintype C] (draw : C → Challenges K) (Q : ℕ)
    (law : Sem1Uniform draw Q) (t : Trace K) :
    eventMass (fun c => zeroEvent t ((draw c).sem 0) ((draw c).sem 1)) ≤ (4096 : ℚ)/Q := by
  exact (eventMass_mono _ _ (fun c h => contained t _ _ h)).trans (pole_mass_le draw Q law t)

#print axioms contained
#print axioms mass
end R1Z.PV_Inv_PoleMass

import R1Z.PV_Inv_PoleMass
import R0Z.FsAbortBounds
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_Inv_PoleUnion
open R0Z.JointView R0P R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HvzkV
open PoleMassR1 PV_Inv_PoleMass
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

theorem eight_attempts {C : Type} [Fintype C] (draw : Fin 8 → C → Challenges K) (Q : ℕ)
    (law : ∀ i, Sem1Uniform (draw i) Q) (t : Trace K) :
    eventMass (fun c => ∃ i, zeroEvent t ((draw i c).sem 0) ((draw i c).sem 1)) ≤
      8 * ((4096 : ℚ)/Q) := by
  have h := R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_exists_le_card
    (fun i c => zeroEvent t ((draw i c).sem 0) ((draw i c).sem 1)) ((4096 : ℚ)/Q)
    (fun i => PV_Inv_PoleMass.mass (draw i) Q (law i) t)
  simpa only [eventMass,R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_ofNat] using h

#print axioms eight_attempts
end R1Z.PV_Inv_PoleUnion
